name: Versioned project review standards register, single-level shared inheritance, person rule ownership, and agent drafts
summary: Projects may adopt an explicit versioned review standards register (.standards/head.json and append-only versions/v<N>.json). Projects with no head.json and no versions/ entries behave identically to projects without standards (ignoring pre-v1 drafts/, gate.json, commits/, and waivers/), whereas unreadable head.json or version entries report status damaged. Registers support one-level inheritance from a shared register (shared: true, inherits: <shared_pid>) with read-only inherited must rules, expected_version compare-and-swap on writes, R3a lint (default should severity, all_changes must count warning, ref key checks), person-only rule ownership and direct edits (notifying coordinators via unthrottled project-local member notes over HTTP and .standards/notifications.jsonl on the host, never accepted over the contributor SSH endpoint), departed-owner fallback, and agent/contributor rule drafts.
